A '''vaporator condenser''' was a component associated with [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]]. [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]], once tried to purchase fifty vaporator condensers from the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
